tools.name: workspace.search
tools.description: Search metadata deterministically across nested boards. Defaults to compact title/description matches; body explicitly scans inline text and review notes, never resource files.

tools.name: workspace.recent
tools.description: Return recently updated compact metadata, including deeply nested items and boards.

tools.name: workspace.show
tools.description: Explicit complete workspace export. Expensive at scale; prefer search and targeted inspection.

tools.name: workspace.view
tools.description: Read a metadata header, Home summaries/covers or containment/placement geometry without exporting historical document bodies.

tools.name: workspace.rebuildIndex
tools.description: Rebuild disposable discovery shards from authoritative individual files. Changes no canonical documents.

tools.name: workspace.inspect
tools.description: Read-only parse/identity inventory independent of home membership or discovery cache, including corrupt-header diagnostics.

tools.name: workspace.migrate
tools.description: Preview or explicitly apply legacy conversion. App installation never performs this operation.

tools.name: item.get
tools.description: Read one canonical item without loading unrelated boards or bodies.

tools.name: board.get
tools.description: Read one board, its canonical items and immediate collection covers; never recursively export the workspace.

tools.name: board.geometry
tools.description: Resolve board-space line endpoints, shape bounds and attachment/detached state deterministically.

tools.name: workspace.apply
tools.description: Apply one existing graph operation with normal validation, revision checks and idempotence. Prefer named tools for discoverable schemas.

tools.name: item.create
tools.description: Create a title-only, inline, resource-backed or composite item; files remain project-owned.

path.description: Path relative to a registered project-controlled resource root; no absolute paths.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL without credentials; never executed by Tinka.

tools.name: item.update
tools.description: Update canonical title, description, content, preview, revisions or build metadata.

tools.name: item.review
tools.description: Set the existing canonical review note/star shared across references.

tools.name: item.duplicate
tools.description: Create an independent item using the same resource files; copied boards retain child references.

tools.name: item.archive
tools.description: Archive or restore canonical items across references.

tools.name: item.delete
tools.description: Mark canonical items deleted across references without deleting resource files.

tools.name: board.create
tools.description: Create a board on Home or under a parent; optional existing owner item retains its content.

tools.name: board.update
tools.description: Update board title, review order, existing decorations or background.

items.description: Board-local text, region/shape or line. from/to must occur together on lines. Attached targets must be same-board active placements or non-line decorations; fallback is used only if target later detaches. Omitted region shape preserves existing colored-area behavior.

path.description: Path relative to a registered project-controlled resource root; no absolute paths.

tools.name: placement.update
tools.description: Update placement-local geometry/presentation; notes and content remain canonical.

tools.name: placement.translate
tools.description: Translate selected placements atomically, preserving arrangement and returning movement history.

tools.name: placement.move
tools.description: Move references between boards or into a new board, preserving item identity and files.

tools.name: placement.reference
tools.description: Place the same canonical items elsewhere with shared feedback.

tools.name: placement.archive
tools.description: Archive/restore selected placements only.

tools.name: placement.remove
tools.description: Detach selected placements without deleting canonical items or files; movement history supports undo.

tools.name: placement.paste
tools.description: Paste a validated same-workspace placement snapshot as independent copies.

tools.name: movement.restore
tools.description: Replay an opaque server-authenticated movement receipt for undo/redo.

tools.name: workspace.update
tools.description: Register project-controlled named resource roots outside replaceable app metadata.

tools.name: decoration.create
tools.description: Create text, region/sticky/shape or line with explicit or attached endpoints.

decoration.description: Board-local text, region/shape or line. from/to must occur together on lines. Attached targets must be same-board active placements or non-line decorations; fallback is used only if target later detaches. Omitted region shape preserves existing colored-area behavior.

tools.name: decoration.update
tools.description: Update exactly one board-local decoration, preserving peers; endpoint pair uses board units.

tools.name: decoration.remove
tools.description: Remove one decoration; existing connectors retain honest detached endpoint references.

tools.name: link.preview
tools.description: Read bounded public HTTP(S) metadata for an explicitly supplied URL; does not execute remote HTML or write resources.

tools.name: files.import
tools.description: Import 1–20 local image/PDF files through the same validated import transaction. Paths are CLI-only; resource files remain outside app.

tools.name: feedback.list
tools.description: List compact feedback summaries by board/item or inspect one complete thread. Cursor binds the workspace revision. Point results include anchorPoint with resolved x/y and detached/fallback flags. Actor names are self-reported.

tools.name: feedback.comment
tools.description: Add a general, board-point, item or exact text-quote comment. Optional point relative:{x,y} fractions (0–1) require one target and follow its bounds; x/y retains the creation fallback. Author is a self-reported local identity.

tools.name: feedback.reply
tools.description: Append a human or agent reply to a stable feedback thread.

tools.name: feedback.resolve
tools.description: Resolve or reopen a feedback thread without losing its messages.

tools.name: item.vote
tools.description: Set one current yes/no/abstain vote per self-reported actor on a canonical item. null clears that actor’s vote; references share votes.

tools.name: highlight.add
tools.description: Save a bodyless text highlight on a canonical item. Current local Markdown/inline text only; exact source facts or a unique quote/context are resolved once. Fixed yellow, max200/256KiB per item. No comment or source edit.

tools.name: highlight.list
tools.description: Read bounded persistent highlights and current source-match status for one item; no source body. Cursor binds item and workspace revision.

tools.name: highlight.remove
tools.description: Remove only the specified highlight metadata ID. Missing mark is an idempotent removed:false result; source files and discussion remain unchanged.
